steps.title: Mount the motor
steps.action: Seat the plate on the motor pilot. Tighten four M3 x 6 socket caps into the motor.

steps.title: Load the cage nuts
steps.action: Turn the lower cage over. Seat one M2 nut in every tooth pocket; hold the nuts while turning it upright.

steps.title: Lower the cage onto the plate
steps.action: Fit the prepared cage teeth upward. Point its small service hole toward the motor shaft flat (+X).

steps.title: Load the eccentric joint nuts
steps.action: Press two M2 nuts into the underside of the lower eccentric. Keep the central D bore clear.

steps.title: Load the shaft-clamp nut
steps.action: Seat the M3 nut in the radial hex pocket. Align its thread with the side screw hole.

steps.title: Start the shaft-clamp screw
steps.action: Start the M3 x 8 countersunk screw in the nut. Leave its tip clear of the D bore.

steps.title: Fit the eccentric to the shaft
steps.action: Slide the prepared eccentric over the D shaft. Align the clamp screw with the shaft flat and snug it through the cage port.

steps.title: Load the lower clamshell nuts
steps.action: Turn the lower wave clamshell over and seat four M3 nuts. Hold them in place for the next step.

steps.title: Fit the lower wave clamshell
steps.action: Lower the prepared clamshell around the eccentric journal, bearing recess upward. Retain all four nuts.
steps.scope: Main assembly - motor omitted for clarity

steps.title: Seat the 6704 bearing
steps.action: Fit the 6704 over the eccentric journal and into the lower clamshell recess. Seat it squarely.

steps.title: Close the eccentric shaft
steps.action: Fit the upper eccentric collar. Tighten two M2 x 16 countersunk screws into the nuts loaded in step 04.

steps.title: Close the wave clamshell
steps.action: Fit the upper wave half around the 6704. Tighten four M3 x 8 socket caps evenly into the lower nuts.

steps.title: Fit the fixed outer ring
steps.action: Lower the fixed ring around the cage. Align its six fins with the base and its service hole with the cage port (+X).
steps.scope: Main assembly - motor omitted for clarity

steps.title: Insert all twelve rollers
steps.action: With the eccentric pointing toward +X, drop one nylon spacer into every cage slot. Use 7 mm OD x 12 mm spacers.

steps.title: Load the upper cage nuts
steps.action: Turn the upper cage over. Seat four M3 nuts in the off-grid underside pockets, then hold them while turning it upright.

steps.title: Close every cage tooth
steps.action: Fit the prepared upper cage. Install one M2 x 18 countersunk screw per tooth, through the disc and into each lower nut.

steps.title: Fit the 6810 output bearing
steps.action: After tightening all twelve cage screws, seat the 6810 around the upper cage hub.

steps.title: Load the housing nuts
steps.action: Seat six M3 nuts in the top pockets of the bearing housing. Keep the bearing mouth facing downward.

steps.title: Lower the bearing housing
steps.action: Lower the prepared housing over the bearing outer race. Line up all six screw fins with the fixed ring and base.
steps.scope: Main assembly - motor omitted for clarity

steps.title: Join the case from below
steps.action: Insert six M3 x 30 socket caps upward through the base and fixed ring. Tighten evenly into the housing nuts.

steps.title: Load the five M6 attachment nuts
steps.action: On the bench, put the nut carrier hex pockets upward. Seat five M6 nuts at the centre and the four full-grid positions.

steps.title: Load the eight M3 attachment nuts
steps.action: Seat eight M3 nuts in the remaining half-grid and corner pockets. Leave the four off-grid assembly holes clear.

steps.title: Fit the loaded nut carrier
steps.action: Keep all thirteen nuts upright. Lower the carrier inside the 6810 bore onto the upper cage hub; align the four fixing holes.

steps.title: Close the OOBB output face
steps.action: Fit the cover. Tighten four M3 x 12 socket caps in the off-grid holes into the upper cage nuts. Leave the OOBB holes free.

steps.title: Tighten through the service port
steps.action: Align the case port, cage port and shaft screw. Use a 2 mm hex driver with a shaft no larger than 2.4 mm. Withdraw it before turning.
steps.tools:
2 mm hex driver
Shaft diameter <= 2.4 mm

steps.title: Turn the drive by hand
steps.action: With power disconnected, turn the input 12 times. The output should turn once in reverse. Check for free motion and the 0.8 mm gap below the output face.

bip39_method: OOMP MD5(UTF-8 identity), BIP39 entropy encoding, first three words. These are identification labels, not recovery phrases. Project-local IDs are explicitly marked in the inventory.
